title: a cancellation while a final `defer await` waits interrupts the deferred work and the task ends cancelled
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events.

stdout.text:
body done
cancel requested
task -1 cancelled true
body done
cancel requested
outer -1 cancelled true

provenance.origin: authored for #739 from the #601 K2 probes; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #739, K2 probe `finaldefer`: the task's body has produced 7 and its `defer await` waits on an event when main cancels the task. A `defer await` is not shielded: the cancellation is delivered at the deferred await, the deferred work does not finish, and the task (or the action awaiting it) ends Cancelled.
